text: Idiopathic [Gr. idiopaqein , to feel for oneself alone]: Ger. idiopathisch ; Fr. idiopathique ; Ital. idiopatico . A term applied to a morbid condition or disease which is primary and distinctive; not a secondary effect of another disorder, nor a symptom of such disorder, nor the result of accident or injury. It thus often implies the typical and hereditary form of the disease, as idiopathic epilepsy, idiopathic insanity. ( J.J. )
